status: Proposed fixture; owner adoption and real browser verification pending
authorization: Parent relayed the owner's separate permission to author a local diagnostic SVG/image resource; this is not approval of the fixture bytes or an implementation plan.

authoring.method: Authored directly as readable SVG markup by the W2 preparation coding assistant in this task
authoring.purpose: Deterministic native img resource for cover-crop, intrinsic size, load, delayed response, source-change and failure checks after approval
authoring.externalInputs: No photographs, stock assets, private blobs, image-generation service or copied third-party artwork
authoring.copyrightOrRightsVerification: Not performed; no photographer, attribution, photo quality or rights certification is claimed

asset.labelFont: Generic monospace within diagnostic image data only; no downloaded/embedded font and no component typography permission
asset.renderingLimit: Coordinates, palette and labels are fixed; glyph rasterization and native img/error rendering vary by browser/system font. Native decode and visual suitability have not been tested.

palette.whyLiteralImageData: An external SVG img does not inherit the page's token custom properties. Existing primitive values are pinned inside the self-contained diagnostic resource, not added as component style values or new tokens.

diagnostics.landmarks: NORTH/TOP EDGE and SOUTH/BOTTOM EDGE bands; WEST/LEFT and EAST/RIGHT bands; Q1-Q4 quadrants; central crosshair
diagnostics.square: 1:1 source in square viewport retains the full grid; all five focal choices coincide because no cover overflow is expected.
diagnostics.portrait: 4:5 viewport crops horizontally: left/center/right choices expose different side landmarks. Top/bottom should coincide when there is no vertical overflow.
diagnostics.landscape: 4:3 viewport crops vertically: top/center/bottom choices expose different edge landmarks. Left/right should coincide when there is no horizontal overflow.
diagnostics.geometryStatus: Analytical cover-fit expectations only, not observed browser measurements. Border, frame inset, rotation and caption are excluded from the viewport ratio.
diagnostics.informativeAltCandidate: Diagnostic grid with labelled north, south, west and east edges, four numbered quadrants and a central crosshair.
diagnostics.captionCandidate: Diagnostic crop fixture, not a photograph.
diagnostics.failureProcedure: Parent-owned browser routing may return an explicit 404 for the same approved resource request. Do not replace the image with this diagnostic artwork as a runtime fallback.
diagnostics.loadingProcedure: Parent-owned browser routing may hold and then release these exact bytes. Browser/native callback and reserved geometry checks belong to later approved runtime validation.
diagnostics.sourceChangeProcedure: Use cache-distinct same-origin query URLs serving identical pinned bytes to test source-change routing; do not invent a second photography asset.
